For rows with nonempty validated prior, compute NO_CONTEXT via frozen Model.predict(original_rows,no_context=True,no_tail=False,same_deadline). Do not delete current tokens or zero the tail. No prior:skip second inference and markNOT_APPLICABLE; no fake tested agreement.

For each enabled headj, pF=sigmoid(zF),p0=sigmoid(z0),sF=(pF>=tau_j),s0=(p0>=tau_j). If unequal, audit stateUNRESOLVED. If equalpositive,AGREED_SELECTED_PROPOSAL. If equalnegative,AGREED_NOT_SELECTED, not evidence of semantic absence. tau>1:DISABLED regardless raw scores.

Row statusUNRESOLVED if any enabled head flips; also record domain_disagreement and aux_disagreement separately. Conflicting source-act heads do not erase agreeing domain heads; conflicting domain heads do not select the opposite arm or automatically replace primary intent.
